title:
Lambanog, a traditional Filipino alcohol product made from coconut juice, made its debut at the International Trade Fair for Wine and Spirits (ProWine Shanghai) at the Shanghai New International Expo Center.

ProWine Shanghai, a trade fair for wine and other alcoholic drinks which opened on Tuesday, was attended by about 620 wine and spirits companies from 34 countries and regions around the world.
